adjudication.finding: Original photo contains background carrots and pineapple; single-food label is inappropriate. Original 14/15 score retained. Final model also hallucinated/truncated its food list; the program rejected it. This is not credited as successful full scene understanding.

limitations: The same image set was used for prompt development; these are not independent blind tests.
No representative user accuracy, physical microphone, full paid browser, deployment or invoice/free-quota claim.
Catalogue membership cannot prove that the model correctly described the source image.
